name: suede-offers
description: Suede AI offer design and persuasion mechanics: scores the offer on the Suede Value Levers (outcome, confidence, wait, effort), then builds bonuses that each remove an objection, guarantees and risk reversal matched to the buyer's real risk, honest scarcity and deadlines that meet FTC, UK, and EU consumer rules, naming, and payment structure, plus evidence-tiered behavioral models (anchoring, framing, social proof, loss aversion, defaults) stated as testable hypotheses. Returns an Offer Brief. U
author: JasonColapietro
